# Modified for PrufGate evaluation: public example destinations replaced with example.com.
import httpx
import requests

# Errors
requests.get('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
requests.get('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
requests.post('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
requests.post('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
requests.put('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
requests.put('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
requests.delete('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
requests.delete('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
requests.patch('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
requests.patch('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
requests.options('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
requests.options('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
requests.head('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
requests.head('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)

# Okay
httpx.request('GET', 'https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.request('GET', 'https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.get('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.get('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.options('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.options('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.head('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.head('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.post('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.post('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.put('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.put('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.patch('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.patch('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.delete('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.delete('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.stream('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=True)
httpx.stream('https://example.com', timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.Client(timeout=30)
httpx.Client(timeout=30, verify=False)
httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30)
httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30, verify=False)
